## Objective
- Build a complete, playable open-world 3D-style game in Portuguese with character customization, vehicles, work and crime paths, home, money, and licensing consequences.

## Requirements
- User requested an open world with different weapons, player character choices, cars and motorcycles to steal and dismantle, delivery/taxi work, a starter automatic low-quality motorcycle, a house, and R$250 starting cash.
- Driving without a license should incur a R$250 fine and 3 license points.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- User requested screenshots for checks to be small JPEGs at most 1280px wide, reading only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone browser game using Canvas 2D with a pseudo-3D/isometric city presentation; no external game engine.
- Crime/weapon elements are roleplay-only; weapons are equipment with no combat.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html` with Portuguese UI, character name/look selection, city canvas, minimap, cash/license/points/energy/heat HUD, mobile controls, work actions, vehicle interactions, home rest, and dealer shop.
- Added delivery/taxi job routes and vehicle dismantling interactions.

### Active
- Validate and fix JavaScript syntax/runtime issues in `index.html`.
- Check visual/playable behavior after syntax is corrected.

### Blocked
- `node --check` failed with `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of input` at `/tmp/opencode/game.js:59`.
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` could not run because Chromium is not installed; no screenshot check completed.
- The intended local server command did not start because syntax validation was chained before server startup.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the end of the `<script>` in `index.html` and fix the unmatched/missing brace or other syntax issue.
2. Extract script and rerun `node --check`.
3. Start a local server, then test in a browser if available; capture a small JPEG and inspect the latest screenshot.
4. Fix any runtime/gameplay defects, particularly shop interactions, vehicle behavior, and job target completion.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: entire game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The initial implementation makes actions in the right-side “PONTOS DA CIDADE” panel teleport the player to that location when far away.
- The implementation includes theft fine/points, but current interaction logic applies this on any unowned vehicle theft.
- Script syntax check command used: `sed -n '/<script>/,/<\\/script>/p' index.html | sed '1d;$d' > /tmp/opencode/game.js && node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.
